facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog article '3 essential audiences for conversion campaigns' was published on 2022-05-26.
The page defines audience targeting as using data to segment consumers by demographics or interests to find the right users, devices, and moment.
facts.quote: Audience targeting uses data to segment consumers by demographics or interests in order to find the right users, on the right devices, and at the right moment.

facts.fact: The page defines retargeting as delivering online ads to a user based on their previous intent-based actions on the web.
facts.quote: With retargeting you’re able to deliver online ads to a user based on their previous intent-based actions on the web.

facts.fact: The page advises that a tracking pixel must be placed on all pages of a website to build an audience pool of site visitors for retargeting and conversion tracking.
facts.quote: To build an audience pool of site visitors, you will need to place a tracking pixel on all pages of your website.

facts.fact: The page states that excluding certain audiences from campaigns can keep costs down by avoiding spend on people unlikely to convert.
facts.quote: Excluding certain audiences from your campaigns can keep your costs down and prevent you from spending money on people that you know won’t convert.
